title: Personal Injury Professionals Networking Mixer
summary: July's mixer at Mizner Park drew the largest Palm Beach County turnout of the year so far.
description: The July stop pulled a heavier Palm Beach County crowd than usual — a lot of first-time attendees from firms north of Boca who had been watching the mixers from a distance.
The room ran long. We had the space until 9:00 and people were still talking at 9:40.

hero.alt: Attorneys and medical providers in conversation at an MMG networking mixer

recap.headline: 108 in the room and nobody left early.
body: Our biggest Palm Beach County turnout to date. Thirty-one first-time attendees, which is the highest share we've had at any mixer this year.
Thank you to The MRI Guys, Better Wellness Clinic, Earley Law Firm, and LienStar for making the evening possible — and to everyone who stayed past close to finish a conversation.

photos.alt: Attendees talking in small groups at the July mixer
photos.caption: The room at 7:15, about an hour in.

photos.alt: Two professionals in conversation at an MMG event
photos.caption: Introductions turning into real conversations.

comments.author: Tessa Moreau
comments.body: Best one yet. Met three providers I'd only ever emailed with. Rafael, good to finally put a face to the reports.

comments.author: Rafael Ibarra
comments.body: Likewise Tessa. Sent over that scheduling contact this morning.

comments.author: Beatriz Nunes
comments.body: Mizner Park was a great call. Easy parking, and being able to spill outside made a big difference to how the room felt.

comments.author: Andrew Miller
comments.body: Appreciate everyone who came out. We'll be back in Boca in the spring — and August is Fort Lauderdale, waterfront patio. Details are up now.
